blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Self-supervised vision transformers trained with DINO-style objectives exhibit striking emergent semantic representation quality across visual tasks, yet the mechanisms underlying this behavior remain unclear. We present a systematic empirical dissection of the DINO family and show that semantic representations arise primarily from enforcing consistency between geometrically distinct global views of the same image instance. This instance-specific global alignment acts as the semantic anchor of DINO-style learning. Across controlled retraining experiments evaluated on semantic correspondence and a diverse suite of 2D and 3D downstream tasks, we find that patch-level masking objectives enhance semantics only when trained jointly with this global alignment, indicating that the iBOT objective refines and densifies existing semantic structure rather than creating it independently. In contrast, local-to-global view alignment does not substantially improve semantic qualities at fixed compute beyond a purely global alignment. Beyond training design, we revisit how semantic representation quality should be evaluated: while classification accuracy is the standard validation score, semantic correspondence provides a complementary axis that more reliably predicts downstream task performance. Together, these findings provide a functional decomposition of DINO-style learning and represent an important step toward understanding how semantic representations emerge in self-supervised vision models.
blocks.zh: 用DINO式目标培训的自我监督的视觉变压器在视觉任务中表现出惊人的即兴语义表现质量,然而这种行为背后的机制仍然不清楚。 我们提出了DINO家族的系统的经验解剖,并表明语义表达主要产生于对同一图像实例的几何特征不同的全球观点之间的一致性。 这种针对具体实例的全球校正,是DINO风格的学习的语义锚. 通过对语义函授和多种2D和3D下游任务进行评估的受控再培训实验,我们发现,补丁级遮盖目标只有在与这种全球对齐联合训练时才会增强语义,这表明iBOT目标完善和去化了现有的语义结构,而不是独立创建. 与此相对照,地方与全球观点的一致在固定计算上并没有大大改善语义的品质,超出了纯粹的全球一致。 除了培训设计外,我们重新审视应如何评价语义表达质量:虽然分类精度是标准验证分数,但语义对应提供了一个补充轴,更可靠地预测下游任务性能. 这些调查结果共同为DINO式学习提供了功能解析,是了解自我监督的视觉模型中如何出现语义表达的一个重要步骤。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Self-supervised vision transformers trained with DINO-style [ 7 , 35 , 24 ] objectives have emerged as strong general-purpose visual backbones, exhibiting striking semantic structure: features cluster by category, attention maps delineate object boundaries, and learned representations transfer broadly across dense prediction tasks [ 24 ] . The standard training recipe is a tightly coupled system, developed through large-scale empirical engineering: it combines multi-crop view generation [ 6 ] , patch-level masked prediction [ 35 ] , careful augmentation design [ 12 ] , and momentum distillation [ 16 ] . Each component is presented as beneficial, but their individual contributions to semantic representation quality, as opposed to classification accuracy, have not been cleanly isolated. This is the gap our work addresses.
blocks.zh: 以DINO型[7,35,24]目标培训的自我监督的视觉变压器作为强大的通用视觉骨干出现,呈现出惊人的语义结构:特征集群按类别划分,注意地图划定物体界限,学习到的表达方式广泛跨越密集的预测任务转移[24]. 标准训练配方是一个紧密结合的系统,通过大规模的实证工程发展而来:它结合了多作物观光生成[6],补丁水平的蒙面预测[35],精心的增强设计[12],动力蒸馏[16]. 每个组成部分都被表述为有益的,但是它们各自对语义表达质量的贡献,而不是分类准确性,并没有被完全孤立. 这是我们工作地址的空白。

blocks.en: The central ambiguity concerns the interplay between three components of the recipe: global-view contrast between two large crops of the same image, local-to-global alignment that pairs small local crops with global views, and patch-level masked prediction that operates at the token level. Patch-level supervision could plausibly provide the dense correspondence signal underlying semantic structure; equally, global-global agreement alone may constitute a sufficient semantic training signal, with local and patch objectives serving auxiliary roles. The question is not whether these components improve overall benchmark numbers (they do), but which of them creates the semantic structure that DINO-family models are valued for, versus which refine an already-semantic representation.
blocks.zh: 核心的模糊性涉及食谱的三个组成部分之间的相互作用:同一种形象的两种大作物之间的全球视角对比、将当地小作物与全球视角挂钩的局部到全球的对接,以及象征性地运作的补丁层遮掩预测。 补丁层面的监督可以合理地提供构成语义结构的密集的函授信号;同样,光是全球-全球协议就可以构成充分的语义培训信号,地方和补丁目标可以发挥辅助作用。 问题不在于这些组成部分是否改善了总的基准数(它们确实如此),而在于哪些组成部分创造了DINO-家庭模型被重视的语义结构,而后者则完善了一种已经语义化的表述。

blocks.en:
This question fits into a broader research thrust on identifying minimal principles for effective self-supervised learning. Methods such as SimDINO [ 32 ] and LeJEPA [ 3 ] have shown that many components in the DINOv2 recipe exist primarily to prevent representational collapse, and can be replaced by explicit regularization without loss of performance. Our work is complementary but diagnostic: rather than proposing new objectives, we ask which existing components are responsible for semantic emergence in the learned representation, and which primarily refine downstream task performance such as classification.
We conduct controlled pretraining experiments at a moderate scale, systematically ablating crop configuration (global-only vs. global+local), auxiliary objectives (with and without patch-level prediction), and crop scale. We evaluate all variants using a comprehensive suite that includes classification (kNN, linear probe), semantic and geometric correspondence (SPair-71k, NAVI), and dense downstream tasks spanning depth estimation, pose, point tracking, and semantic segmentation (NYU, ImageNet3D, TAPVid, ADE20K). This dual evaluation axis, classification alongside correspondence, turns out to be essential for correctly interpreting representation quality.
blocks.zh:
这个问题符合更广泛的研究方向,即确定有效自我监督学习的最低限度原则。 SimDINO[32]和LeJEPA[3]等方法表明,DINov2配方中有许多成分主要是为了防止代表性崩溃而存在的,可以被明确的正规化代替而不失去性能. 我们的工作是互补的,但具有诊断性:我们不是提出新的目标,而是问哪些现有组成部分负责在学到的表述中出现语义,哪些组成部分主要完善分类等下游任务绩效.
我们以适度的规模进行有控制的预先训练试验,有系统地模拟作物的布局(只针对全球+局部)、辅助目标(有和没有补丁水平的预测)和作物规模。 我们使用一个包括分类(kNN,线性探测器),语义和几何对应(SPair-71k,NAVI),以及跨越深度估计,姿势,点跟踪和语义分化(NYU,ImageNet3D,TAPVid,ADE20K)的密集下游任务,对所有变体进行评估. 这一双重评价轴,与对应的分类,对正确解释代表质量至关重要。

blocks.en: Our central finding is that same-instance global alignment, consistency between two geometrically displaced global crops of the same image, acts as a semantic anchor for DINO-style learning. Two global crops with the DINO loss alone, without local crops or patch-level prediction, already yield representations with strong semantic structure and competitive performance across the dense evaluation suite. Adding local crops improves classification accuracy substantially but leaves correspondence largely unchanged; adding patch-level prediction (iBOT) refines correspondence quality ( 10.5 PCK points) but is not its source. Necessity tests further confirm that removing geometric displacement between views, or replacing same-image crops with crops from different instances, each collapses semantic correspondence, pinpointing same-instance geometric alignment as the operative inductive bias.
blocks.zh: 我们的核心发现是,同样的全球协调,同像的两种几何迁移的全球作物之间的一致性,成为DINO式学习的语义锚。 仅是DINO损失的两种全球作物,没有当地作物或补丁水平的预测,已经产生了具有强烈语义结构的表示和整个密集评价套间的竞争表现。 添加局部作物可大大提高分类精度,但使对应物基本保持不变;添加补丁级预测(iBOT)可提高对应物的质量(10.5 PCK点),但不是其来源. 必要测试进一步证实,消除不同观点之间的几何异位,或用不同情况下的作物取代相同形象的作物,每一次都会产生语义上的对应,并明确与实际的诱导性偏差相同。

blocks.en: This observation motivates a closer look at how representation quality is measured. Classification accuracy is sensitive to recipe choices in ways that do not predict dense downstream utility: in fixed-scale crop experiments, classification peaks at s=0.40 while correspondence and dense downstream tasks peak at s=0.60–0.72. Across our experimental sweep, semantic and geometric correspondence correlate substantially more strongly with dense downstream performance than kNN or linear probes. We therefore argue that semantic correspondence should be treated as a first-class evaluation axis alongside classification, not as a replacement, but as a necessary complement when the goal is to understand semantic emergence rather than classification transfer.
blocks.zh: 这一观察促使人们更仔细地审视如何衡量代表的质量。 分类精度对食谱选择很敏感,不会预测密集的下游用途:在固定尺度的作物实验中,分类峰值为s=0.40,而对应和密集的下游任务峰值为s=0.60-0.72. 与kNN或线性探测器相比,在我们的实验扫射过程中,语义学和几何学对应学与密密的下游性能的联系要强得多。 因此,我们主张,应把语义对应与分类一起作为一等评价轴,而不是替代,而是在目标是理解语义的出现而不是分类转移时作为必要的补充。

blocks.en: Through a systematic and principled decomposition of the DINO training recipe, we arrive at the following findings: (i) Same-instance global-view alignment is the semantic anchor of DINO-style SSL : it is sufficient to produce strong semantic patch features, and removing geometric displacement or same-instance identity each collapses semantic correspondence. Local crops and patch-level prediction refine this representation (local crops by contributing to classification accuracy through view diversity, iBOT by sharpening correspondence quality), but neither creates the semantic structure. (ii) Validating SSL recipes by classification accuracy can systematically misjudge dense-task utility : classification and dense correspondence have opposing crop-scale optima (s=0.40 vs. s=0.60–0.72 in fixed-scale experiments). (iii) Semantic and geometric correspondence predict dense downstream performance more reliably than kNN or linear probes across our experimental sweep, motivating their inclusion as first-class evaluation axes for SSL.
blocks.zh: 通过对DINO训练配方的系统化和有原则的解析,我们得出了以下结论:(一) 同声全球视野对齐是DINO风格SSL的语义主锚:它足以产生强烈的语义补丁特征,并去除每一次崩溃语义对应的几何位移或同声特征. 局部作物和补丁级预测细化了这种表述(局部作物通过视图多样性促进分类精度,iBOT通过提高对应质量),但两者都不产生语义结构. (二)通过分类精度验证SSL配方可系统性地误判密-任务效用:分类和密-函式有对立的作物尺度Ottima(s=0.40对s=0.60–0.72在固定尺度实验中). (三) 语义学和几何学对应学比kNN或线性探测器更可靠地预测我们整个实验扫描的下游密集性能,促使它们成为SSL的一流评价轴。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Self-supervised visual representation learning has advanced through increasingly complex training recipes, yet the mechanisms responsible for semantic structure remain poorly understood.
We review the lines of work most relevant to this diagnostic question, spanning view generation strategies, training objectives, and evaluation methodology.
blocks.zh:
自我监督的视觉表现学习通过日益复杂的培训配方得到了进步,然而负责语义结构的机制仍然不甚了解.
我们审查与这一诊断问题最相关、涉及造景战略、培训目标和评价方法的工作范围。

blocks.en: Self-supervised learning and the two-view paradigm. Self-supervised visual representation learning has converged on a two-view paradigm: a network produces similar embeddings for augmented views of the same image and dissimilar ones for different images [ 12 , 8 , 18 ] . Subsequent methods showed that competitive representations emerge from two-view agreement even without negative pairs [ 16 , 9 ] , with redundancy-reduction methods [ 33 , 5 ] offering an alternative route to collapse avoidance via explicit feature decorrelation. We take this paradigm as our starting point and identify which specific properties of two-view alignment (geometric displacement across views, same-instance identity, and the global contrastive loss) are each necessary for semantic structure to emerge.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的学习和双景范式. 自我监督的视觉表现学习已经趋同于一种双视范式:一个网络为同一图像的放大视图产生类似的嵌入,为不同的图像产生不同的嵌入[12,8,18]. 其后的方法表明,竞争性的表述来自两观点协议,即使没有负对[16,9],而冗余-减少方法[33,5]提供了通过明确特征装饰避免倒闭的另一种途径。 我们将此范式作为出发点,确定两种观点一致的具体特性(不同观点的几何迁移、同质特征和全球对比性损失)是出现语义结构所必需的。

blocks.en: Multi-crop and local-global view strategy. SwAV [ 6 ] introduced the multi-crop strategy, mixing two large global crops with several small local crops per image. DINO [ 7 ] adopted this within a self-distillation framework where local views match representations derived from global views, and multi-crop has since become a de-facto standard in DINO-family recipes. Whether local-to-global alignment specifically contributes to semantic representation quality, as opposed to improving classification or training efficiency, has not been systematically isolated. Our ablations show that removing all local crops leaves correspondence largely unchanged, challenging the assumption that local-to-global matching is the operative mechanism for semantic emergence.
blocks.zh: 多作物和地方-全球观点战略。 SWAV [6] 引入了多作物战略,将两种大型全球作物与每个图像的几种小型当地作物混合在一起. DINO[7]在自我消化的框架内采纳了这一点,当地观点与全球观点形成的观点一致,多作物从此成为DINO-家庭配方的事实上的标准. 地方与全球的配合是否具体有助于语义表述的质量,而不是提高分类或培训效率,并没有被系统地孤立。 我们的描述表明,清除所有当地作物基本上没有改变对应关系,对地方与全球匹配是语义出现的运作机制这一假设提出了挑战。

blocks.en: Patch-level objectives and masked image modeling. Masked image modeling [ 4 , 17 ] strengthens spatial representations through token-level supervision; iBOT [ 35 ] integrated this into the DINO self-distillation framework, and DINOv2 [ 24 ] adopted it alongside large-scale data curation. Token-level supervision is widely interpreted as the primary driver of dense semantic correspondence. We directly test this assumption: removing iBOT degrades but does not collapse correspondence, while training with iBOT alone produces near-zero correspondence, establishing it as a refiner rather than a creator of semantic structure.
blocks.zh: 补丁级目标和蒙面图像模型. 蒙面图像模型[4,17]通过符号级监督加强空间表示;iBOT[35]将此纳入DINO自沉框架,DINov2[24]与大规模数据解析一起采用. 托肯级监督被广泛解释为密集语义通信的主要驱动力. 我们直接测试这个假设:去掉iBOT降解但不会崩溃的函证,而仅使用iBOT的训练就产生近零的函证,将其确立为精炼器而不是语义结构的创造者.

blocks.en: Simplifying self-supervised learning pipelines. A growing body of work simplifies SSL recipes by identifying which components are necessary for stable optimization. SimDINO [ 32 ] replaces DINOv2 heuristics with explicit variance regularization without performance loss; LeJEPA [ 3 ] proposes more principled objective formulations; recent work also shows that augmentation needs decrease with data scale [ 23 ] . These efforts ask which components can be removed without accuracy loss; we ask which components create semantic structure: orthogonal questions, since a component can be removable (replaced by a functionally equivalent alternative) yet still be the causal origin of a capability.
blocks.zh: 简化自主监管的学习管道. 越来越多的工作通过确定稳定优化所需的组件来简化SSL配方. SimDINO [32] 以明确的差异正规化取代DINOv2 Heuristics,而不造成性能损失;LeJEPA [3] 提出了更具原则性的客观表述;最近的工作还表明,随着数据尺度的扩大需求减少[23]. 这些努力询问哪些组件可以在不丧失准确性的情况下被移除;我们询问哪些组件会产生语义结构:正交问题,因为一个组件可以被可移动(被功能等同的替代品所取代),但仍然是一个能力的因果源.

blocks.en: Probing learned representations. Evaluating SSL representations has historically relied on classification-based probes [ 8 , 7 ] , which provide only an indirect view of the spatial structure in dense patch representations. Recent work uses ViT patch features as zero-shot dense descriptors for semantic correspondence, co-segmentation, pose estimation, and 3D understanding [ 1 , 15 , 13 , 14 , 31 ] , and similar correspondence emerges in diffusion features [ 29 , 20 ] . However, correspondence metrics have been used primarily as post-hoc capability assessments, not as functional analysis tools to identify which training components give rise to semantic structure. We use SPair-71k [ 22 ] and NAVI [ 19 ] as zero-shot diagnostic probes across all ablation variants, and show that they predict dense downstream performance more reliably than classification proxies ( Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 探究所学说法. 评估SSL表达式在历史上一直依赖基于分类的探针[8,7],这些探针只提供了密集补丁表达式中空间结构的间接视角. 近期的作品使用ViT补丁特性作为零射致密描述符,用于语义函证,共分,姿势估计,以及3D理解[1,15,13,14,31],类似函证出现于扩散特性[29,20]. 然而,函证衡量标准主要用于进行任务后能力评估,而不是作为功能分析工具,以确定哪些培训部分产生语义结构。 我们使用SPAIR-71k [22] 和NAVI [19]作为所有膨胀变体的零射诊断探测器,并显示它们比分类代理更可靠地预测密集的下游性能(第4.4节).

两种大型全球作物(比例为 QQ [s min, 1.0]\ in [s_{\ min}, 1.0], 默认的 s min = 0.32 s_{\ min 0.32)和

blocks.en:
DINOv2 [ 24 ] adds a patch-level self-distillation
objective from iBOT [ 35 ] : a fraction of student input patches are
masked, and the student’s features at masked positions are aligned with the
teacher’s unmasked features via a per-patch cross-entropy loss with its own centering and softmax.
The full objective is ℒ DINOv2 = ℒ DINO + ℒ iBOT \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{DINOv2}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{DINO}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{iBOT}} ,
which can be read as global-view [CLS] alignment + masked patch-level refinement .

教师的无假象特征,通过每平方尺的跨性损失,并带有自己的中枢和软马克。

blocks.en: 3.2 Interventions
blocks.zh: 3.2 发言

blocks.en:
We compare the full DINOv2 objective (D+I), DINO only (D), and iBOT only
without any global contrastive signal (I).
blocks.zh:
我们比较了DINov2的全部目标(D+I),DINO只(D),iBOT只
没有任何全球对比信号(I).

blocks.en:
We vary the multi-crop schedule along three dimensions. Global crop count : from one (1G) to four (4G), varying the strength of the global contrastive signal. Local crops : removing all local crops (2G vs. 2G+8L) isolates whether local-to-global matching is necessary for semantic emergence. Crop type : photometric-only views apply distinct photometric augmentations to the same spatial crop; cross-instance views pair crops from different images within the same ImageNet synset.
These isolate which property of global-to-global contrast is strictly necessary.
blocks.zh:
我们按照三个维度来改变多作物的时间安排。 全球作物计数:从1(1G)到4(4G),变化全球对比信号的强度. 本地作物 : 移除所有本地作物(2G vs. 2G+8L) 隔离本地到全球的匹配对于语义的出现是否必要. 裁剪类型:仅用光度测量视图对同一空间作物采用不同的光度放大;从同一图像Net合成集的不同图像中进行交叉视图对等作物。
它们孤立了全球与全球对比的哪些财产是绝对必要的。

blocks.en: We further sweep the global crop scale under two regimes using the DINO global-to-global loss: (i) random-scale sweep varying s min s_{\min} in [ s min , 1 ] [s_{\min},1] , and (ii) fixed-scale sweep drawing both crops at the same scale [ s , s ] [s,s] , which removes scale stochasticity entirely.
blocks.zh: 我们利用DINO全球对全球的损失,在两种制度下进一步扫荡全球作物规模:(一) 在[smin, 1] [s_{\min],1] 中随机扫荡不同分寸的(s_{\min, 1),以及(二) 将两种作物画成同样规模的(s, s ],s]),完全消除了规模的划时代性。

blocks.en: We do not intervene on photometric augmentations, as they are necessary for SSL pretraining at smaller scale [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们不干预光度增强,因为光度增强对于小规模的SSL预训是必要的。

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价议定书

blocks.en: kNN top-1 ( k = 10 k{=}10 ) and linear probe top-1 on ImageNet-1k using frozen [CLS] features, following standard practice [ 8 , 7 , 24 ] .

blocks.en:
Zero-shot nearest-neighbour matching on frozen patch features [ 1 , 13 ] . SPair-71k [ 22 ] measures cross-instance semantic (Sem.) correspondence via PCK@0.1. NAVI [ 19 ] measures within-instance geometric (Geom.) correspondence via R@0.05m.
We further validate both as proxies for dense downstream task performance via correlation analysis in Section 4.4 ; full downstream task details are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
All models use a ViT-L/16 backbone trained for 100 epochs on ImageNet-1k under the low-compute regime of DINOv2 [ 24 ] .
Unless stated otherwise, view generation follows the default multi-crop recipe described in Section 3.1 : two global crops at scale [ 0.32 , 1.0 ] [0.32,1.0] and eight local crops at scale [ 0.05 , 0.32 ] [0.05,0.32] , with photometric augmentations.
Classification is evaluated via frozen-feature kNN ( k = 10 k=10 ) and linear probing on ImageNet-1k.
Semantic quality is measured via zero-shot patch-feature correspondence on SPair-71k (PCK@0.1) and NAVI (R@0.05m), as defined in Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh:
所有模型都使用在DINov2 [24] 的低计算制度下,在ImageNet-1k上为100个纪元培训的Vit-L/16主干线.
除非另有说明,视图生成遵循第3.1节所述默认的多作物配方:两种全球作物的规模[0.32,1.0][0.32,1.0]和八种当地作物的规模[0.05,0.32][0.05,0.32][0.032],并带有光度增强。
在ImageNet-1k上通过冷冻度kNN(k = 10k = 10)和线性检测来评价分类.
语义质量通过SPair-71k(PCK@0.1)和NAVI(R@0.05m)上的零射补丁-feat通信进行测量,定义见第3.3节.

blocks.en: 4.1 Model Size
blocks.zh: 4.1 型号大小

blocks.en:
Before ablating individual components, we first establish how model capacity affects classification and correspondence, and select a backbone that balances performance with the compute cost of running many ablations.
We train DINOv2 across five architectures (100 epochs each, except ViT-g/14 at 300 epochs; details in Section A.2 ) and report results in Table 1 .
Correspondence is more sensitive to scale than classification: semantic correspondence nearly doubles from ViT-S/16 to ViT-L/14 ( 24.8 → 47.3 24.8{\to}47.3 ) while kNN gains only 12 points.
ViT-g/14 does not improve over ViT-L/14 on correspondence despite more parameters and longer training, suggesting overfitting to ImageNet-1k at this data scale.
We fix ViT-L/16 for all experiments: it gives the best correspondence among patch-16 models at a favorable compute-to-performance trade-off.
blocks.zh:
在设定单个组件之前,我们首先确定模型能力如何影响分类和对应,并选择一个能够平衡性能和运行许多模拟的计算成本的骨干.
我们训练DINov2 跨越五个建筑(每个建筑100个纪元,除VIT-g/14在300个纪元;详情见A.2节),结果见表1。
函授比分类更敏感:语义函授从ViT-S/16到ViT-L/14(24.8~47.3~24.8~to}47.3)几乎双倍,而kNN只获得12分.
ViT-g/14在函授方面没有比ViT-L/14改进,尽管有更多的参数和更长的训练,暗示在这个数据尺度上过度适合ImageNet-1k.
我们为所有的实验修复VIT-L/16:它给补丁-16模型之间的最佳对应,以有利的计算对性能的权衡.

blocks.en: On the scale of our experiments. This 100-epoch ViT-L/16 regime is the standard low-compute setting of DINOv2 [ 24 ] , consistent with SimDINO [ 32 ] and LeJEPA [ 3 ] . The over 20 ablation configurations we study would be computationally prohibitive at the full DINOv2 data scale.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验规模上 这个100世纪的Vit-L/16制度是DINov2 [24]的标准低计算设置,与SimDINO [32] 和LeJEPA [3]一致. 我们所研究的20多个膨胀配置,在计算时将无法在完整的DINOv2数据尺度上实现。

blocks.en: 4.2 Intervention Ladder: Progressive Component Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 干预阶梯:渐进组件分析

blocks.en:
We systematically remove components from the DINOv2 recipe one at a time and measure effects on both classification and correspondence ( Table 2 ).
A central finding is that the two axes respond differently to each removal, revealing a dissociation between what drives classification quality and what gives rise to semantic representations.
blocks.zh:
我们系统地从DINOv2食谱中逐一删除一个成分,并衡量对分类和对应的影响(表2)。
一个中心结论是,两轴对每次去除的反应不同,揭示了驱动分类质量和引起语义表达的区别.

blocks.en:
Dropping the iBOT patch-prediction loss while retaining the DINO objective reduces DINOv2 to DINOv1.
Classification drops modestly (kNN 80.4 → 79.1 80.4{\to}79.1 , linear 80.6 → 79.3 80.6{\to}79.3 ), and correspondence degrades (Sem. 42.5 → 32.0 42.5{\to}32.0 , Geom. 77.1 → 73.9 77.1{\to}73.9 ), but crucially does not collapse.
DINOv1 patch features retain strong semantic structure, a result invisible to classification metrics alone.
The 10.5 pp semantic correspondence gap is non-trivial: iBOT is a substantial refiner .
We characterize it as a refiner rather than a creator because global-only DINOv1 (two global crops, no local crops) already establishes structured correspondence (Sem. 31.2), while iBOT trained without the DINO loss collapses entirely (Sem. 6.8; Table 3 ), demonstrating it cannot bootstrap semantic structure independently.
iBOT’s quantitative contribution is substantial within a working pipeline, and its relative role may increase at larger data scales.
blocks.zh:
在保留DINO目标的同时,将 iBOT 补丁预测损失降低到 DINov1 。
分类下降幅度不大(kNN 80.4~79.1 80.4~to}79.1,线性80.6~79.3 80.6~to}79.3),函文退化(Sem.42.5~32.0 42.5~to}32.0,Geom 77.1~73.9 77.1~to}73.9),但关键是不会崩溃.
DINOv1补丁特征保留了强烈的语义结构,这种结果仅是分类度量法所看不见的.
iBOT是一个实质性的精炼器。
我们将其定性为精炼剂而不是创造剂,因为全球唯一的DINOv1(两种全球作物,没有本地作物)已经建立了结构化的对应关系(Sem. 31.2),而iBOT训练时没有DINO损失完全崩溃(Sem. 6.8;表3),证明它不能独立靴子语义结构.
(单位:千美元) BOT的量化贡献在工作流程中是巨大的,其相对作用可能在更大的数据尺度上增加。

blocks.en:
Removing the eight local crops from DINOv1 while retaining only two global views produces a striking asymmetric effect .
Classification drops substantially (kNN: 79.1 → 72.4 79.1{\to}72.4 , linear: 79.3 → 72.6 79.3{\to}72.6 ), yet semantic and geometric correspondence shift only marginally (Sem. 32.0 → 31.2 32.0{\to}31.2 , Geom. 73.9 → 72.0 73.9{\to}72.0 ).
If local-to-global matching were the operative mechanism for semantic emergence, removing it should collapse correspondence, yet it does not. Local crops are not the source of semantic structure. They contribute to classification-oriented quality by increasing view diversity, but the semantic content of patch features is established by global-view contrast alone .
We refer to DINOv1 on two global crops with no local crops as the minimal configuration .
blocks.zh:
将当地八种作物从DINOv1中移除,
分类大幅下降(kNN:79.1~72.479.1~to}72.4,线性:79.3~72.679.3~to}72.6),但语义学和几何学的函证只略有变化(Sem.32.0~31.2 32.0~to}31.2,Geom.73.9~72.0 73.9~to}72.0)。
如果本地与全球的匹配是语义出现的运作机制,删除它就会崩溃函证,但不会。 当地的作物不是语义结构的来源. 它们通过增加视图多样性而促进面向分类的质量,但补丁特征的语义内容仅由全局视角对比确定.
我们提到两种全球作物的DINov1,

blocks.en:
If local crops primarily supply view diversity rather than a qualitatively distinct signal, substituting additional global views should partially recover the classification gap.
DINOv1 with four global crops reaches kNN 74.6 and linear 75.7, recovering roughly half the gap to full DINOv1, with essentially unchanged correspondence (Sem. 32.9, Geom. 73.7).
Notably, four-global DINOv1 (Sem. 32.9) marginally exceeds full DINOv1 (Sem. 32.0), suggesting that in the DINO-only regime local crops mildly reduce correspondence relative to additional global crops; this does not alter the conclusion that view count primarily benefits classification. Additional views benefit classification, but are not the cause of semantic emergence.
blocks.zh:
如果当地作物主要供应者看到多样性,而不是质量上截然不同的信号,则替代更多的全球观点应部分恢复分类差距。
具有4种全球作物的DINOv1达到kNN 74.6和线性75.7,将大约一半的缺口恢复到完全的DINOv1,对应物基本不变(Sem 32.9, Geom 73.7.
值得注意的是,四个全球的DINov1(Sem 32.9)略微超过完全的DINov1(Sem 32.0),这表明在只使用DINO的制度中,当地作物略微减少与额外全球作物的对应关系;这并没有改变主要考虑利益分类的结论。 其他观点有利于分类,但不是语义出现的原因.

blocks.en: 4.3 Necessity Tests: What Makes Global-View Contrast Work?
blocks.zh: 4.3 必要性试验: 是什么让全球视网膜对比工作?

blocks.en:
Having established two global same-instance crops as a sufficient minimal configuration, we now isolate which property of that signal is operative.
We design four targeted experiments, each disabling one candidate mechanism; results are in Table 3 .
blocks.zh:
在建立了两个全球同质作物作为足够最低限度的配置之后,我们现在孤立了该信号的哪些属性是起作用的。
我们设计了四个有针对性的实验,每个实验都使一个候选机制失效;结果见表3。

blocks.en:
Table 3 : Necessity tests. Each condition removes one property from the minimal two-global-view DINOv1 configuration,
which serves as the reference (top row).
Subscripts show the drop ↓ {\color[rgb]{1,0,0}\downarrow} from the reference.
Losses: D = DINO, I = iBOT.
blocks.zh:
表3:必要性测试。 每个条件都会从最小的双全景DINov1配置中移除一个属性,
用作参考(上行)。
下标显示参考文献中的 \\ color [rgb]{ 1, 0, 0\ downarrow} 。

blocks.en:
Training with iBOT but without the DINO objective leads to near-complete collapse: kNN 1.8, Sem. 6.8.
Patch features carry no meaningful semantic structure, ruling out the possibility that patch-level prediction alone can bootstrap semantic representations.
blocks.zh:
用iBOT进行训练,但没有DINO目标导致近乎完全崩溃:kNN 1.8,Sem 6.8.
补丁特征没有带有意义的语义结构,排除了补丁水平的预测单是能够靴子语义表达的可能性.

blocks.en:
The global contrastive objective is a strict prerequisite. Importantly, iBOT applies its own centering and softmax to patch-token predictions, so training dynamics are not destabilized by missing centering; the collapse is not a stability artifact.
Rather, patch-level self-distillation, even with intact centering, is insufficient to bootstrap global semantic structure; it requires the CLS-level contrastive objective as a foundation.
blocks.zh:
全球对照目标是一个严格的先决条件。 重要的是,iBOT将自己的中心与软马克用于补丁键预测,因此训练动态不会因为缺少中心而不稳定;崩溃并非稳定文物.
相反,补丁级的自我消化,即使具有完好无缺的中心,也不足以抑制全球语义结构;它要求将CLS级的对比性目标作为基础.

blocks.en:
Training with a single global crop and 8 local crops reduces kNN to 47.0 and linear accuracy to 57.0; semantic correspondence collapses to 10.6 and geometric correspondence to 58.8.
Even with full photometric augmentation, the absence of a global-to-global contrastive signal eliminates semantic structure. Two-view global alignment is necessary, not merely beneficial.
blocks.zh:
使用单一全球作物和8个当地作物进行的培训将kNN减少到47.0,线性精度减少到57.0;语义通信崩溃到10.6,几何对应到58.8.
即使完全的光度放大,缺乏一个全局到全局的对比信号也会消除语义结构. 需要双管齐下,而不仅仅是有利的。

blocks.en:
We replace geometrically displaced global crops with four photometric augmentations of the same global crop.
Classification remains above chance (kNN 22.4, linear 38.5), reflecting residual photometric invariance, but semantic correspondence degrades to 20.1 and geometric correspondence to 68.2. The operative signal is geometric: the model must align representations across spatially displaced views of the same instance.
blocks.zh:
我们用同一种全球作物的4个光度放大值来取代几何学上流离失所的全球作物。
分类仍然高于概率(kNN 22.4,线性 38.5),反映残余的光度偏移,但语义函证降解为20.1,几何函证降解为68.2. 操作信号是几何的:模型必须使同一情况在空间上不同观点之间的表示一致。

blocks.en:
We replace same-image global crops with crops from two different images within the same ImageNet synset (4 total crops, two per instance).
Classification remains above chance (kNN 31.0, linear 38.3), yet semantic correspondence collapses to 7.3 and geometric correspondence falls to 57.3.
The cross-instance result (Sem. 7.3) is comparably low to the iBOT-only result (Sem. 6.8); both indicate collapse. Class-level semantic similarity cannot substitute for within-instance geometric alignment.
blocks.zh:
我们用来自同一ImageNet合成物中两个不同图像的作物取代了同一图像的全球作物(4个总作物,每例2个)。
分类仍然高于概率(kNN 31.0,线性38.3),但语义函证崩溃为7.3,几何函证下降为57.3.
交叉式结果(Sem. 7.3)与iBOT-只得到的结果(Sem. 6.8)相当低;两者均表示崩溃. 类的语义相似性不能取代内几何对齐.

blocks.en: Three necessity tests converge on a single conclusion: semantic emergence requires alignment across geometrically displaced, same-image, global views. Removing global-to-global contrast (no-global-contrast condition), geometric displacement (no-spatial-displacement condition), or same-instance identity (cross-instance condition) each causes severe degradation while classification remains non-trivially above chance. A fourth experiment (iBOT-only) confirms that the iBOT objective cannot substitute for this signal: even with intact centering, patch-level self-distillation alone fails to bootstrap semantic structure.
blocks.zh: 三个必要性测试集中在一个单一的结论上:语义的出现需要几何相位移,同象,全球观点的一致. 消除全球与全球的对比(无全球冲突条件)、几何迁移(无空间迁移条件)或同种身份(交叉状态)都会导致严重退化,而分类仍无三重性。 第四个实验(iBOT-只)证实iBOT目标不能代替这个信号:即使有完好无损的中枢,单是补丁级的自我沉淀也未能靴子语义结构.

blocks.en: 4.4 Crop Scale Analysis: Classification and Correspondence Have Opposing Optima
blocks.zh: 4.4 作物规模分析:分类和函授有反对意见

blocks.en:
The global views in our minimal configuration are generated by RandomResizedCrop with scale drawn uniformly from [ s min , 1 ] [s_{\mathrm{min}},1] .
The experiments in Section 4.2 hold this schedule fixed; here we ask how sensitive classification and correspondence are to crop scale, and whether they respond in the same direction.
We study two complementary settings: • Random scale [ s min , 1 ] [s_{\mathrm{min}},1] : vary s min ∈ { 0.16 , … , 0.84 } s_{\mathrm{min}}\in\{0.16,\ldots,0.84\} , controlling scale-range diversity. • Fixed scale [ s , s ] [s,s] : both crops drawn at the same fixed scale s s , removing scale stochasticity entirely and isolating the effect of crop size .
blocks.zh:
我们最小配置中的全局观点是由 RandomRegizeCrop 生成的,其比例尺统一来自 [s min, 1] [s_{\mathrm{min}}, 1].
第4.2节中的实验使这个时间表固定下来;我们在此询问,对作物规模的分类和对应如何敏感,它们是否朝同一方向反应。
我们研究两个互补的设置: 随机比例 [s min, 1] [s_{\mathrm{min}}, 1] : s_{\mathrm{in\{0.16,\ldots,0.84\},控制比例范围多样性。 • 固定规模[s, s] [s, s]:两种作物均以相同的固定规模S, 完全消除了规模的花样,并隔离了作物大小的影响。

blocks.en: Random scale [ s min , 1 ] [s_{\mathrm{min}},1] : vary s min ∈ { 0.16 , … , 0.84 } s_{\mathrm{min}}\in\{0.16,\ldots,0.84\} , controlling scale-range diversity.
blocks.zh: 随机比例 [s min, 1] [s_{\mathrm{min}}, 1] : s_{\mathrm{in\{0.16,\ldots,0.84\},控制比例范围多样性。

blocks.en: Fixed scale [ s , s ] [s,s] : both crops drawn at the same fixed scale s s , removing scale stochasticity entirely and isolating the effect of crop size .

Taken together, the scale experiments deliver two conclusions.
First, the operative inductive bias for semantic correspondence is the geometric alignment of spatially overlapping views , maximized at larger crop scales.
Second, this property is a better predictor of dense downstream utility than classification accuracy.

其次,这个属性比分类精度更能预测密集的下游效用.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
Same-instance geometric view alignment is the operative inductive bias for semantic emergence; iBOT and local crops are engineering refinements rather than its source.
The DINO loss alone recovers most of the correspondence quality of the full DINOv2 recipe (75% of semantic PCK and 93% of geometric R@.05).
blocks.zh:
同位素几何视图对齐是语义出现时的操作诱导偏差;iBOT和当地作物是工程改进而不是其来源.
仅DINO损失就恢复了全DINov2食谱的大部分对应质量(75%的语义PCK和93%的几何R@.05).

blocks.en:
Several limitations bound the scope of these conclusions.
How the relative contribution of each component scales with data size and training duration remains open; the relative gains we identify may shift at larger scale and data diversity, even if the primacy of view-alignment as the operative inductive bias holds.
Our analysis is also specific to DINO-style teacher–student SSL; whether the same inductive bias governs semantic emergence in other SSL families remains an open question.
We do not analyse DINOv3 [ 28 ] , which scales beyond our fixed compute budget.
We also do not ablate batch size or self-distillation dynamics (EMA, centering), as these govern training stability and cannot be removed without confounding the training regime itself; we leave their interaction with semantic emergence to future work.
blocks.zh:
这些结论的范围受到若干限制。
如何保持每个组成部分的尺度在数据规模和培训期限方面的相对贡献;我们确定的相对收益可能在更大的规模和数据多样性方面转移,即使视向调整作为实际的诱导偏差的首要地位仍然存在。
我们的分析也针对DINO风格的教师-学生SSL;其他SSL家庭的语义出现是否受到同样的诱导偏差的制约,仍然是一个有待解决的问题。
我们不分析DINov3 [28], 其规模超出了我们的固定计算预算。
我们也不降低批量规模或自我消化动力(EMA,中枢),因为这些动力制约着训练稳定性,不能在不混淆训练制度本身的情况下去除;我们把它们与语义性出现的互动留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We have presented a systematic analysis of semantic emergence in DINO-style SSL, showing that same-instance global-view alignment is the semantic anchor of DINO-style learning, sufficient to produce strong semantic patch features and necessary for them to emerge. iBOT refines this structure (10.5 PCK points) but does not create it; local crops contribute view diversity that benefits classification but not correspondence; and necessity tests confirm that geometric displacement and same-instance identity are both strictly required.
As a methodological contribution, we show that semantic and geometric correspondence metrics (evaluated on SPair-71k and NAVI) track downstream performance more faithfully than classification accuracy, and advocate for their routine inclusion in SSL evaluation.
Together, these findings clarify what DINO-style training actually learns, offer a simplified recipe that preserves correspondence quality, and provide a functional analysis for evaluating future SSL methods.
blocks.zh:
我们对DINO风格SSL中语义学的出现进行了系统分析,显示同声全球视野对接是DINO风格学习的语义主锚,足以产生强烈的语义补丁特征,并且是出现这些特征所必需的. iBOT改进了这一结构(10.5 PCK点),但并没有创造它;当地农作物贡献了有利于分类而非对应的视角多样性;必要性测试证实,几何位移和同质特征都是严格的要求.
作为一种方法上的贡献,我们表明语义和几何对应计量(在SPair-71k和NAVI上评价)比分类准确性更忠实地跟踪下游的性能,并倡导将其例行纳入SSL评价.
这些调查结果共同澄清了DINO式的培训实际学到了什么,提供了一种简化的食谱,保留了函证质量,并为评估未来的SSL方法提供了功能分析.

blocks.en:
To select the model architecture for our experiments, we train three
DINOv2 variants (ViT-L/16, ViT-L/14, and ViT-g/14) on ImageNet-1k and
evaluate each checkpoint on ImageNet-1k kNN classification (Top-1, k k =10),
SPair-71k semantic correspondence (PCK@0.1), and NAVI geometric correspondence
(R@0.05m); see Figure A1 .
Despite its substantially larger capacity, ViT-g/14’s kNN accuracy saturates
at the same level as the ViT-L models, indicating that the model overfits
the ImageNet-1k classification task.
Strikingly, even after 3 × 3\times more training iterations (374k vs. 124k),
ViT-g/14 never surpasses ViT-L/14 on SPair ( ∼ \sim 47.2% vs. 47.3%),
and its additional training beyond 124k iterations yields no improvement on
NAVI either, confirming that additional compute does not translate into better
correspondence at this data scale
On NAVI, all three models converge to ∼ \sim 77% R@0.05m by 124k
iterations; ViT-g/14 starts lower (57.7% at 12k iterations) but catches
up by ∼ \sim 100k, after which further training yields no additional gain.
Meanwhile, the coarser patch size of ViT-L/16 reduces the number of tokens per
image, yielding better training throughput at only a modest ∼ \sim 5% reduction in SPair performance (42% vs. 47%).
Based on these results, we adopt ViT-L/16 for all subsequent experiments.

Figure A2 : PCA visualization of patch features under different component interventions. Each row shows RGB maps of the first three principal components (PC1–3) of ViT-L/16

(elephant, bear, vehicle; backgrounds masked to black). DINO minimal (2 global crops, same image) already produces spatially coherent,
part-consistent colorings across instances, demonstrating that global same-instance crops
alone suffice for semantic feature emergence.
More global crops from the same image ( DINO 4G ) further improve consistency,
while cross-instance views ( DINO 2G+2G ) and replacing global crops with local
ones ( DINO 1G+8L : 1 global + 8 local) both degrade structure severely.
Training with iBOT alone is similarly ineffective, confirming that the DINO
self-distillation loss is the operative signal.
Standard DINOv1 (2G+8L, DINO loss only: PCK@.1 = 32.0) closely matches DINO minimal (31.2), confirming that local crops add only marginal benefit. DINOv2 (same 2G+8L recipe plus iBOT: PCK@.1 = 42.5) demonstrates that
the iBOT patch loss, not the local crops, drives the large gain over DINO minimal .
Quantitative results in Table 2 corroborate these observations.

blocks.en:
We compare the spatial structure of ViT-L/16 patch features across a controlled set of
training objectives by projecting each image’s patch tokens onto the first three
principal components (PC1–3) and rendering them as an RGB map
(Figure A2 ).
PCA is fitted jointly over foreground tokens within each category, so that consistent
colors across images reflect part correspondences rather than instance-specific appearance.

我们比较了VIT-L/16补丁特性的空间结构。
通过将每个图像的补丁符号投影到前三个选项来进行训练目标
主要组件(PC1-3),并作为 RGB 映射
(图A2).
五氯苯甲醚在每一类的前缘标志上共同安装,以便一致
跨图像的颜色反映了部分对应而非特定实例的外观.

blocks.en:
Already with two global crops of the same image ( DINO minimal ), the PCA maps
show smooth, spatially coherent color gradients that are consistent across instances:
the trunk, body, and legs of different elephants receive the same relative hues,
and analogous structural regions of different vehicles are assigned similar colors.
These part-consistent groupings emerge from the self-distillation signal alone,
without local crops or patch-level objectives.
The maps of DINO 4G are nearly indistinguishable from those of DINO minimal (colors may vary per row, but correspondence remains consistent), consistent with the small quantitative gain
(PCK@.1: 31.2 → \to 32.9).
When views share the same spatial crop and differ only photometrically
( DINO 1G4P : 1 global crop, 4 color-jittered variants), the smooth
gradients give way to patchier, less consistent colorings; semantic part groupings
are visibly weaker, indicating that geometric diversity across views is a
necessary condition for structure to emerge.

Replacing same-image crops with views drawn from two different image instances
( DINO 2G+2G ) produces visually fragmented, mottled maps: the smooth
gradients are replaced by a speckled, texture-like pattern with no stable part
groupings across instances.
Despite retaining global crops with geometric diversity, the network cannot form
part-consistent representations when views depict the semantics of different image instances;
the self-distillation target is corrupted at its source.

blocks.en:
The PCA maps of DINOv1 (2G+8L, DINO loss) are consistent with those of DINO minimal (2G, no local crops): the
same smooth gradients and part groupings appear in both rows, with differences
difficult to perceive at this scale, consistent with a negligible quantitative
change (PCK@.1: 31.2 → \to 32.0).
Removing global context and keeping only local crops ( DINO 1G+8L :
1 global + 8 local) produces fragmented, incoherent colorings similar to the
cross-instance failure case, confirming that local crops alone cannot sustain
the spatial signal needed for semantic structure.
Training on the patch-level iBOT objective alone ( iBOT only ) collapses
further: the maps are nearly uniform within each silhouette, with almost no spatial
color variation, indicating that the DINO self-distillation loss is the main operative signal and not the patch reconstruction. DINOv2 , which adds the iBOT loss to the same 2G+8L recipe as DINOv1 , produces the richest part structure visually; the gap between
them traces directly to the iBOT objective, while the foundational semantic
organisation is already established in DINO minimal .

blocks.en: Appendix D Bootstrap confidence intervals for correlation analysis
blocks.zh: 附录D 关联性分析的靴子置信间隔

blocks.en:
Figure A3 shows 95% bootstrap confidence intervals (10,000 non-parametric resamples) for the Pearson correlations between each proxy metric and each dense downstream task, across all three experimental settings (component interventions, random-scale sweep, fixed-scale sweep).
Depth RMSE is sign-flipped before computing correlations so that higher values consistently indicate better downstream performance.
The intervals confirm that semantic and geometric correspondence metrics achieve higher mean correlation with dense tasks than kNN or linear probe across all settings, with the gap most pronounced in the fixed-scale sweep.
blocks.zh:
图A3显示在三种实验环境(组件干预、随机规模扫描、固定规模扫描)中,皮尔逊每个代理度量衡和每个密集的下游任务之间95%的皮尔逊置信间隔(10,000个非参数重印)。
深度RMSE在计算关联性之前是标志式闪烁的,这样更高的值就一致地表明下游性能更好.
间隔证实,语义和几何对应度测量值与密度任务相比,在所有设置中,密度任务或线性探测值达到更高的平均相关性,在固定尺度扫描中差距最为明显。
